messages.subject: RE: Project Sable - VAT registration and option to tax
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

You'll need to provide written confirmation, before completion, that the buyer (i) is registered for VAT, (ii) has opted to tax the property and notified HMRC with effect no later than the completion date, and (iii) will not revoke the option. We'll prepare the form of confirmation letter for signature.

The option needs to be notified to HMRC by completion (21 November), so please aim to have the notification in by mid-November to be safe. We can use the 30-day email notification route.

Best,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
